title: The Advanced Sword Affinity Companion
summary: A companion for those past the courses that adds the settled sword qi cut and a guard that holds through a long exchange.

title: Canon of the Weighted Sword Qi
summary: A canon on adding the weight of the body and dense qi to the edge so cuts crush guards and hold their ground.

title: Treatise on the Sword Held Beyond the Hand
summary: A treatise on letting qi extend the sword past the steel so the cut reaches farther and the guard covers more.

title: Canon of the Many Edges
summary: A canon on splitting one sword stroke into many edges of qi that cut together and guard together.

title: The Twin Track Sword Manual
summary: A manual of paired cuts and paired guards that runs the body and the blade down two tracks at once.

title: Treatise on the Hawk's Descending Edge
summary: A treatise on plunging cuts from above and the spread wing guard that follows each stoop of the blade.

title: The Azure Court of Two Swords
summary: A manual of cutting and guarding with two swords of qi at once so one stroke opens the guard and the other lands.

title: The Oath-Sworn Sword Bearing
summary: Teaches a sword sworn to one bearing that is taken and held through every cut and guard of the exchange.

title: Treatise on the Held Bearing of the Edge
summary: A treatise on taking a bearing with the sword and holding the edge on it though the opponent shifts.

title: Canon of the Unwalled Sword
summary: A canon of open and unbarred sword work that keeps no fixed guard and answers every line with a free edge.
